parsed.post: Latest experiment with MATRIX_LR=0.06 yielded 1.022643, which is worse than our current best of 1.009912. Reverting to 3734fbf. It seems 0.06 is too high for this depth/budget configuration. I will now try to reduce the learning rate slightly to 0.04 to see if a more conservative approach allows for better convergence.
parsed.description: Decrease MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to test if a more conservative learning rate improves convergence for the DEPTH=6 model within the 5-minute budget.
